name: Remote MCP Server on Cloudflare (Authless)
description: A template for deploying a Model Context Protocol server to Cloudflare Workers without requiring authentication. It enables the hosting of remote tools that can be accessed via SSE by the Cloudflare AI Playground or local clients like Claude Desktop.
